declaration.preface:
Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. is committed to conducting its operations in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner while delivering high-quality Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, API pellets, and specialty chemical products to customers worldwide.

As a responsible pharmaceutical manufacturer, the Company strives to minimize the environmental impacts associated with its operations by promoting pollution prevention, efficient resource utilization, responsible waste management, energy conservation, water stewardship, and climate-conscious practices. Environmental considerations are integrated into business planning, operational decision-making, and manufacturing processes to enhance operational efficiency and support sustainable growth.
declaration.declaration:
The objectives of this Environmental Stewardship Policy are to:

Establish a structured framework for managing environmental aspects and impacts across all business operations.

Ensure compliance with applicable environmental laws, regulations, permits, and other statutory requirements.

Prevent pollution by minimizing emissions, effluent discharges, waste generation, and other environmental impacts arising from the Company's activities.

Promote the efficient use of energy, water, raw materials, and other natural resources to improve environmental performance.

Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and support initiatives that contribute to climate change mitigation and operational resilience.

Encourage responsible management of hazardous chemicals, wastes, and other environmentally significant materials throughout their lifecycle.

Establish measurable environmental goals and monitor performance to drive continual improvement in environmental management.
declaration.scope:
This Environmental Stewardship Policy applies to all operations, manufacturing facilities, research and development centers, warehouses, utilities, laboratories, and corporate offices of Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. under its operational control.

The Policy is applicable to:

All permanent, temporary, contractual, probationary, and trainee employees of the Company.

The Board of Directors, senior management, and all functional departments responsible for environmental management and compliance.

Contractors, consultants, service providers, and agency personnel performing work on behalf of the Company.

Suppliers and business partners, where relevant, who are encouraged to support environmentally responsible practices consistent with the principles of this Policy.

All activities, processes, products, and services that have the potential to impact the environment, including resource consumption, emissions, effluent generation, waste management, chemical handling, transportation, and infrastructure development.

focusAreas: Materials Sourcing, Chemicals Safety and Waste Disposal

Energy Management and Carbon Footprint: We are committed to improving energy efficiency across our manufacturing facilities, laboratories, utilities, warehouses, and administrative offices by optimizing operational processes, enhancing equipment performance, and adopting energy-efficient technologies wherever technically and economically feasible.

We will identify, monitor, and evaluate energy consumption and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions on a periodic basis to establish performance benchmarks, support data-driven decision-making, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Aim to conduct regular energy audits across major manufacturing facilities to identify energy-saving opportunities and improve energy efficiency.
Plan to increase the inclusion of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations, renewable electricity procurement, and other feasible clean energy solutions.
Seek to introduce energy-efficient technologies and equipment, including LED lighting, high-efficiency motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and efficient utility systems.
Plan to establish a structured GHG emissions inventory covering Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions and progressively assess significant Scope 3 emission categories.

We are committed to reducing Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions through improved fuel efficiency, process optimization, preventive maintenance of utility equipment, and the gradual integration of cleaner energy sources and renewable energy solutions where feasible.

We will progressively assess significant Scope 3 emission categories, including purchased goods and services, transportation and distribution, business travel, waste management, and other relevant value chain activities, and work with stakeholders to identify emission reduction opportunities.

We will comply with all applicable legal, regulatory, and permit requirements related to energy use, air emissions, and climate-related obligations, while aligning our environmental management practices with recognized industry standards and best practices.

We will promote employee awareness and encourage responsible energy management through regular training, communication, and engagement initiatives, fostering a culture of energy conservation and climate responsibility across the organization.
We are committed to implementing an effective Energy Management System and pursuing alignment with the requirements of ISO 50001 to strengthen energy performance and continual improvement.
Water Stewardship: We are committed to conserving water by improving water-use efficiency across manufacturing operations, utilities, laboratories, cooling systems, and support functions through process optimization and responsible water management practices.

We will strengthen water recycling, reuse, and recovery initiatives by maintaining efficient wastewater treatment systems and exploring opportunities to maximize the utilization of treated water wherever operationally feasible.
Aim to conduct periodic water audits and water balance assessments to identify major consumption areas, water losses, and conservation opportunities.
Plan to introduce or expand rainwater harvesting systems at operational facilities where technically and geographically feasible.
Seek to increase the reuse and recycling of treated wastewater for suitable applications such as utilities, cooling, cleaning, and landscaping.
Plan to introduce water-efficient technologies and equipment across significant water-consuming processes and support functions.

We are committed to protecting water resources by ensuring that wastewater generated from our operations is treated, monitored, and managed in accordance with applicable environmental regulations, consent conditions, and internal environmental standards.
We will regularly monitor water consumption, identify areas of high water usage, and implement improvement initiatives that contribute to long-term water conservation and operational sustainability.

We will enhance employee awareness on responsible water management through periodic training, awareness programs, and participation in water conservation initiatives across all operational facilities.
Product Disposal and Recycling: We are committed to promoting responsible product stewardship by considering environmental aspects throughout the product lifecycle and encouraging environmentally sound management practices where applicable.

We will provide relevant environmental, safety, and handling information to customers and business partners to facilitate the safe transportation, storage, use, and disposal of our products in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

We are committed to continually evaluating opportunities to improve packaging efficiency and encourage the use of recyclable or environmentally preferable packaging materials, where technically feasible and commercially viable.
Plan to conduct lifecycle-based environmental assessments for selected products to identify opportunities for reducing environmental impacts.
Explore opportunities to introduce take-back, recovery, or recycling initiatives for selected packaging materials where feasible.
Seek to reduce unnecessary packaging materials without compromising product quality, safety, or regulatory requirements.
We will engage with customers and other stakeholders to promote responsible product lifecycle management practices that support environmental protection and resource conservation.
Environmental Community Engagement: We are committed to fostering a culture of environmental responsibility by integrating environmental considerations into business planning, operational decision-making, and day-to-day activities across the organization.

We will conduct regular environmental awareness and competency-building programs for employees and contractors to strengthen understanding of environmental responsibilities, regulatory compliance, and sustainable work practices.
Plan to expand employee participation in environmental volunteering activities, including tree plantation, clean-up drives, and conservation initiatives.

We are committed to collaborating with regulatory authorities, industry associations, academic institutions, suppliers, and local communities to promote environmental awareness, responsible industrial practices, and sustainable development.

We will periodically review environmental performance, encourage employee participation in environmental initiatives, and recognize opportunities that contribute to continual environmental improvement.

We are committed to adopting the principles of green chemistry by promoting higher atom economy, reducing reaction steps, minimizing hazardous substances, and improving process efficiency throughout product development and manufacturing.
Air Quality Management: We are committed to minimizing air emissions from manufacturing processes, utility operations, and support activities through effective pollution control systems, process optimization, and adoption of cleaner production practices.

We will maintain, inspect, and periodically monitor emission control equipment to ensure compliance with applicable environmental regulations, permit conditions, and internal environmental performance standards.
Plan to establish a centralized air-emission inventory covering significant point-source emissions, combustion emissions, process emissions, VOCs, and relevant fugitive emission sources.
Aim to assess opportunities to transition to cleaner fuels and lower-emission technologies for boilers, generators, and other combustion equipment.

Plan to strengthen air pollution control systems through the installation or upgradation of scrubbers, condensers, bag filters, dust collectors, and other appropriate emission-control technologies based on process requirements.

We are committed to reducing fugitive emissions through effective maintenance programs, leak prevention measures, good engineering practices, and responsible management of chemicals and process equipment.

Aim to conduct periodic stack emission monitoring for significant stationary sources, including boilers, thermic fluid heaters, diesel generator sets, and process vents, to assess compliance and identify emission-reduction opportunities.
We will enhance employee awareness regarding air quality management, emission control measures, and environmental compliance through periodic training and operational guidance.
Product Utilization: We are committed to integrating environmental considerations into product development, manufacturing processes, and quality management practices to reduce environmental impacts while maintaining product quality, safety, and regulatory compliance.
We will continuously improve manufacturing processes to optimize material utilization, reduce resource consumption, and enhance process efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.

We are committed to providing appropriate environmental, health, and safety information relating to our products in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements to support their safe handling and responsible use.

We will collaborate with customers, suppliers, and business partners to encourage environmentally responsible product management practices and promote sustainable value creation across the supply chain.
Materials Sourcing, Chemicals Safety and: We are committed to optimizing the use of raw materials, solvents, process chemicals, and packaging materials through efficient manufacturing practices, process innovation, and continuous resource optimization.
Aim to strengthen waste segregation systems covering hazardous, non-hazardous, recyclable, reusable, and recoverable waste streams.
Plan to conduct periodic waste audits to identify opportunities for waste prevention, reuse, recycling, solvent recovery, and resource recovery.
Seek to introduce a chemical substitution assessment process to identify safer or lower-impact alternatives to hazardous chemicals and solvents where feasible.
Plan to expand solvent recovery and reuse initiatives to reduce virgin solvent consumption and hazardous waste generation.

We will promote waste minimization through source reduction, solvent recovery, recycling, reuse, and resource recovery initiatives while striving to advance circular economy principles wherever operationally feasible.

We are committed to ensuring the safe procurement, storage, handling, transportation, treatment, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous materials and wastes in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
We will periodically monitor waste generation, material consumption, and resource recovery performance to identify opportunities for improving material efficiency and reducing environmental impacts.

We will strengthen employee competency through regular training on chemical management, hazardous waste handling, spill prevention, emergency response, and environmentally responsible workplace practices.
Biodiversity: We are committed to minimizing the potential impacts of our operations on biodiversity and surrounding ecosystems by integrating environmental considerations into operational planning and facility management.
We will promote responsible land use, conservation of green spaces, and plantation initiatives, where feasible, to enhance ecological value and contribute to local environmental improvement.

We are committed to identifying and managing activities that may affect natural habitats and ecological resources, implementing appropriate mitigation measures wherever significant environmental risks are identified.

We will periodically review biodiversity-related aspects associated with our operations, raise employee awareness on environmental conservation, and encourage participation in initiatives that support the protection of natural ecosystems and sustainable environmental stewardship.
Customer Health & Safety: We are committed to manufacturing Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, and related products that consistently meet approved quality specifications, customer requirements, and applicable national and international regulatory standards to ensure product quality, safety, and reliability.

We will maintain robust Quality Management Systems (QMS), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), quality risk management, and validated manufacturing processes to prevent contamination, product defects, and quality deviations throughout the product lifecycle.

We are committed to ensuring complete product traceability and maintaining accurate documentation, including Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Batch Packaging Records (BPR), Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and other applicable quality and regulatory documents.

We will establish effective systems for customer communication, product quality complaint management, deviation investigation, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and product recall management, where applicable, to continually strengthen customer confidence and product safety.

We will regularly train employees on Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), data integrity, product quality, contamination control, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance while continuously reviewing product quality performance to drive operational excellence and continual improvement.

policy.monitoring: Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. shall regularly monitor its environmental performance through defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), environmental inspections, compliance evaluations, operational monitoring, and internal audits. Progress against the Company's environmental objectives and quantitative targets shall be reviewed periodically to identify improvement opportunities, ensure regulatory compliance, and support effective environmental management.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Environmental Stewardship Policy shall be reviewed at least once every one years, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable legal or regulatory requirements, business operations, organizational structure, stakeholder expectations, or significant environmental risks and opportunities. Any revisions shall be approved by the appropriate management authority before implementation. The Head of Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Department, in coordination with the Management, shall be responsible for regular review of this policy.
